components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #f3efe7; border: 1px solid #dcd4c8; border-radius: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; color: #2c2c2c; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1); max-width: 360px; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-img { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d9d2c3, #bfae8a); } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 1.25rem; left: 1.25rem; background: rgba(243,239,231,0.9); padding: 0.4rem 1rem; border-radius: 99px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-body { padding: 2rem; text-align: center; } .ds-card-body h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-facts { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #5c5c5c; margin-bottom: 2rem; } .ds-card-link { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #bb924e; }

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like a good concierge: attentive, unhurried, never loud. A warm parchment ground, a high-contrast serif voice, and one brass accent create the sense of a small, personally run house rather than a platform. Photography of real rooms carries the emotion, and the interface stays out of its way.

Density is low and generous. Sections breathe (4rem on mobile, 7rem on desktop), cards center their content, and motion is slow and soft. The system supports two equal audiences, guests deciding on a stay and owners judging a manager, with the same calm register for both.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral ground with a single metallic accent, used sparingly.
Serif display type over a light geometric sans for labels and body.
Pill-shaped actions and generously rounded cards.
Full-bleed photographic hero with a dark scrim and centered white type.
Soft lift on hover; no hard edges or heavy shadows.

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass is the only accent and appears only on actions, eyebrows, and icons. Never use it for large fills, backgrounds, or body text.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans warm. No cool grays and no pure white or pure black grounds.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, Sans Serves Rule
rules.body: Serif is for headings and the mobile menu links only. All controls, metadata, and paragraphs are sans.

rules.name: The Spaced Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is always paired with added letter-spacing (0.05em or more). Never uppercase body-length text.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: No resting shadows. A shadow means the user is interacting with the element.

dos: Do keep Antique Brass (#bb924e) to actions, eyebrows, and icons.
Do use Text Brass (#7d5f2c) whenever brass appears as text on a light ground.
Do keep a visible 2px Charcoal focus ring (3px offset) on every interactive element; it turns white over the hero.
Do put Charcoal text on brass fills; white on brass measures 2.86:1 and fails.
Do pair every uppercase label with at least 0.05em letter-spacing.
Do use the 1.5rem card radius and full-pill buttons together; they define the soft silhouette.
Do let real property photography carry emotion, and keep hero imagery under a scrim so white type stays legible.
Do alternate Parchment and Linen section bands and invert card fills against them.
Do reserve shadows for hover and focus responses.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or use brass as a large surface or body text color.
Don't use cool grays, pure white, or pure black as page grounds.
Don't set body copy or controls in the serif, or headings in the sans.
Don't add resting drop shadows or hard-edged, square cards on desktop.
Don't flatten hero photography under a uniform dark scrim; keep the image readable above the copy.
Don't put Sand Line outline buttons on a Parchment ground; they lose contrast.
Don't assume a dark theme exists. The tokens are defined but unwired.
